1.consolidated_definition: El sujeto de Comerío advertía que a los tamales les llaman algunos civiles, “porque van amarraos por la cintura como los civiles de antes”.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The subject from Comerío warned that some civilians refer to tamales as "because they are tied around the waist like the old-style civilians".
